integrity: The exact formula is proved by prime-power totient divisibility and finite exponent case splits. The general Carmichael conjecture is not claimed. The q=3,5 finite fibers are already in the 2025 source table; Grosswald previously established a criterion implying no singleton at 8q.
scientific_limitations: The proof covers the mirror family only at exponent s=3, not s>=4.
Historical priority is qualified by accessible primary texts and searches.
A finite verifier is corroborating evidence, not an infinite proof.
title: A complete inverse-totient classification at \(8q\) for every odd prime
